description: Configuration for libraries hosted on npm and loaded via @require (only supports UMD bundles or userscript libraries).

pkgName.description: Full identifier of the npm package. Don't add a version number or path here.

path.description: Path to the package's UMD/global bundle file, relative to the library root folder.

global.description: Name of the global variable created in the package's UMD/global bundle.

link.description: Whether the package is locally linked (via npm/yarn/pnpm link). Only enable when actively working on both projects at the same time!
